tool_calls.arguments:
{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "Serial Dilution Drug into PBS", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    tubes = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 2)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 3)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 4)
    
    drug = protocol.define_liquid(name="drug", description="drug stock", display_color="#FF0000")
    pbs = protocol.define_liquid(name="pbs", description="PBS", display_color="#00FF00")
    
    tubes["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=drug, volume=75)
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=pbs, volume=75)
    
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips])
    
    dest_wells = [plate["A1"], plate["A2"], plate["A3"], plate["A4"], plate["A5"], plate["A6"], plate["A7"], plate["A8"], plate["A9"], plate["A10"], plate["A11"], plate["A12"]]
    
    # Fill first well (A1) with 150 ul total (75 ul drug + 75 ul PBS)
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(75, tubes["A1"])
    p300.dispense(75, dest_wells[0])
    p300.mix(5, 80)
    p300.aspirate(75, reservoir["A1"])
    p300.dispense(75, dest_wells[0])
    p300.mix(5, 80)
    
    # Serially dilute across the row
    for i in range(1, len(dest_wells)):
        # Transfer 50 ul from the previous well
        p300.aspirate(50, dest_wells[i-1])
        p300.dispense(50, dest_wells[i])
        # Add 50 ul PBS
        p300.aspirate(50, reservoir["A1"])
        p300.dispense(50, dest_wells[i])
        # Mix
        p300.mix(5, 80)
    
    p300.drop_tip()"}

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "Serial Dilution Drug into PBS", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    tubes = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 2)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 3)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 4)
    
    drug = protocol.define_liquid(name="drug", description="drug stock", display_color="#FF0000")
    pbs = protocol.define_liquid(name="pbs", description="PBS", display_color="#00FF00")
    pbs_blank = protocol.define_liquid(name="pbs_blank", description="PBS blank", display_color="#00FF00")
    
    # Load drug with margin
    tubes["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=drug, volume=125)
    # Load PBS with margin
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=pbs, volume=700)
    # Load PBS blank for negative control
    plate["B1"].load_liquid(liquid=pbs_blank, volume=100)
    
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips])
    
    dest_wells = [plate["A1"], plate["A2"], plate["A3"], plate["A4"], plate["A5"], plate["A6"], plate["A7"], plate["A8"], plate["A9"], plate["A10"], plate["A11"], plate["A12"]]
    
    # Fill first well (A1) with 150 ul total (75 ul drug + 75 ul PBS)
    p300.pick_up_tip()
    p300.aspirate(75, tubes["A1"])
    p300.dispense(75, dest_wells[0])
    p300.mix(5, 80)
    p300.aspirate(75, reservoir["A1"])
    p300.dispense(75, dest_wells[0])
    p300.mix(5, 80)
    
    # Serially dilute across the row
    for i in range(1, len(dest_wells)):
        # Transfer 50 ul from the previous well
        p300.aspirate(50, dest_wells[i-1])
        p300.dispense(50, dest_wells[i])
        # Add 50 ul PBS
        p300.aspirate(50, reservoir["A1"])
        p300.dispense(50, dest_wells[i])
        # Mix
        p300.mix(5, 80)
    
    p300.drop_tip()"}

protocol.py: 3 biology problems (1 error, 2 warnings).

1. ERROR SOURCE-TOO-SHALLOW: The pipette draws air from well A1 in slot 3: the liquid is
below the tip
   line 41:  p300.aspirate(50, reservoir["A1"])
   At line 41 the p300_single_gen2 draws 50 ul from pbs (well A1 in slot 3) with its tip 1
   mm above the bottom of the well. By then the well holds 175 ul, which in this NEST 12
   Well Reservoir 15 mL reaches only 0.84 mm up: the tip is above the liquid and draws air
   (this line did it twice, after 9 times in the liquid; 100 ul of air in all). The
   simulator does not notice: it does not follow the liquid. The 2 wells filled from these
   draws got air instead of liquid.
   Affected: well A1 in slot 3.
   Also reached 2 other wells: wells A11 and A12 in slot 4.
   Fix: Keep the liquid above the tip. This well needs about 258 ul in it for the surface to
   reach 1 mm. Load that much more than the run draws; or draw from a smaller vessel (a tube
   lifts the liquid); or aspirate lower with `well.bottom(0.5)`.
   Source: Opentrons: liquid control (aspirates 1 mm above the bottom of the well by
   default)
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/basic_commands/liquids.html
   Source: Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error
           https://www.bioprocessintl.com/assays/automated-liquid-handlers-as-sources-of-error
   Source: Gilson guide to pipetting (immersion depth 2 to 3 mm for 1 to 100 ul)
           https://solutions.pipette.com/wp-content/uploads/Gilson-Guide-to-Pipetting.pdf
   Source: labautomation.io 7592: negative controls positive after aspirating air
           https://labautomation.io/t/aspiration-dispense-liquid-class-incompatibity/7592
   Source: Integra: 260 ul dead volume in a standard reservoir
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applications/minimizing-dead-volume-during-qpcr-set-divided-reservoir-assist-plus-pipetting-robot
   [36189843acfb]

2. WARNING CONTAM-STOCK: A used tip went into a stock: pbs (well A1 in slot 3)
   line 31:  p300.aspirate(75, reservoir["A1"])
   At line 31 the tip went into pbs (well A1 in slot 3) while it still carried drug (tube A1
   in slot 2) from an earlier step. A tip that has touched one liquid leaves a little of it
   in the next liquid it touches, so this stock now holds material that does not belong
   there. The protocol drew from it again afterwards, but only into wells that were given
   that material on purpose anyway, so this run is not harmed. What is left in the stock is
   no longer clean for the next run.

   out the shared liquid first, while the tip is still clean, and add the other liquids
   afterwards with a fresh tip each.
